meta_title: Jones & Son's Gardening | Local Gardener Sheffield
meta_description: Jones & Son's Gardening in Sheffield. Expert garden design, maintenance and landscaping. Free quotes. Trusted local gardeners since 2005.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — Sheffield's Trusted Gardeners
hero_subhead: Professional garden design, maintenance and landscaping across Sheffield. From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up or a complete garden overhaul, we handle everything from regular maintenance to bespoke landscape design.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, lawn mowing, weeding and seasonal clean-ups. We keep your garden looking sharp throughout the year without the fuss.

services.title: Landscape Design & Installation
services.desc: Custom garden designs tailored to your space and budget. From patios and raised beds to water features and decking — we handle the whole project.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Expert pruning, felling and planting. We'll shape overgrown trees, remove deadwood safely, and advise on species suited to Sheffield's climate.

services.title: Lawn Renovation & Seeding
services.desc: Transform patchy, worn grass into a lush lawn. We scarify, aerate, feed and reseed — or install fresh turf for instant results.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Quality paving and wooden decking that transforms your garden into a real outdoor space. Built to last, designed for entertaining.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Tackle overgrown, neglected gardens. We clear everything responsibly and dispose of waste properly — leaving you with a blank canvas.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own — no shortcuts, just honest work.
about_para_1: Jones & Son's Gardening has been transforming Sheffield gardens for over two decades. Started by local gardener Richard Jones, the business has grown to include his son and a small team of passionate horticulturists. We've built our reputation on reliability, attention to detail, and a genuine love of outdoor spaces.
about_para_2: From family homes to commercial properties, our customers trust us because we listen before we dig. We don't use jargon, we show up on time, and we leave your garden in pristine condition. Many of our customers have been with us for years — and that's exactly how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our back garden. Richard came round, listened to what we wanted, gave us a fair price, and finished ahead of schedule. The new patio and raised beds look amazing. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Have used Jones & Son's for three years now for regular maintenance. They're reliable, tidy, and always leave the garden looking perfect. They even sorted out a problem with our fence without charging extra. Top blokes.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Our garden was a complete mess when we moved in. Richard designed a proper plan, brought it in on budget, and the transformation is incredible. Really professional, no mess left behind. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
